history.limit: Observed samples; not time weighted. Missing fields remain missing; no replacement series or historical ladder is inferred.

liquidity.owner: PegTracker base.liquidity; venue-only DexTracker supplementary inventories
liquidity.basis_declared_by_exit_mark: ALL-IN COST against notional: (output_usd - size) / size. Includes the venue's base spread, so it is not comparable rung-for-rung with a price-impact figure measured against a venue's own spot rung.
liquidity.basis_declared_by_depth: A FLOOR, not a measurement. The deepest rung quoted ($100,000) still clears inside 200bps, so the crossing is somewhere above where we look. Publishing it as '2% depth' would read as a limit we found. SLIPPAGE CONVENTION: TOTAL over the fill (not marginal impact at the margin), measured against this venue's own smallest quoted rung. ⚠️ That reference EXCLUDES the smallest rung's own spread, so the figure is price impact and NOT the holder's all-in cost — which is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Both are real and they answer different questions. The same ladder classifies differently under total vs marginal and under impact vs all-in, so both halves are stated for cross-producer comparison.
liquidity.display: Reads quoted bps as published; added-impact depth subtracts smallest rung baseline. Total output/size is separate. Fees/provider route and observation time retained; no guaranteed redemption or gas-adjusted fill inferred.
